A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
Eigen-AD is a powerful AD-O tool for the Eigen library that provides a high degree of performance and a wide range of features.
Eigen-AD is the first AD-O tool for Eigen which allows the use of symbolically derived derivatives and is therefore able to achieve a performance comparable to the native Eigen code.
Eigen-AD provides an AD tool for Eigen that is competitive with other AD tools for linear algebra libraries and can be easily extended by the AD tool developer.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the AD-O tool can be extended by providing add-on libraries to enable symbolic AD for specific operations.
Eigen-AD can be used to provide a high-performance AD by overloading tool for Eigen and can serve as a template for other libraries.
Eigen-AD is a flexible and efficient AD framework for Eigen and that the proposed techniques can be applied to other libraries as well.
